Saved Views is available today for all customers on paid plans. It lets you capture the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you rely on, so your favorite way of looking at a project is always one click away. Instead of rebuilding the same filtered list every morning, save it once and return to it instantly whenever you need it.

Each user can save up to 50 views, giving individuals and teams plenty of room to organize views by project, priority, sprint, or personal workflow. Once a view is set up, it can be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same filtered perspective without repeating setup steps. Shared views make it easier to align on what matters, whether you're tracking overdue tasks, reviewing a backlog, or monitoring a specific milestone.

Saved Views is included in every paid plan at no additional cost, and it works across all your existing lists and boards right now.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
